Game Overview

In Space Tower, the core idea is straightforward: enter the mesmerizing universe of Space Tower, where patience and precision are your allies. Skillfully bounce your ball to stack soaring cubes and construct unparalleled towers. The strategic thrill and stunning intergalactic visuals create an engaging experience, challenging you to master the art of cosmic construction.
